# spo_tenant_cdn (Data Source)

Look up an existing TenantCdn object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the CDN of this type is enabled.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `origins` (Set of String) CDN origins (relative or absolute paths).
